title: Correlation Explorer
description: A brush-linked scatterplot matrix studio — explore correlations across synthetic or your own CSV data, live.
concept: A statistics workbench built around an NxN scatterplot matrix (SPLOM). Pick 2-5 variables from three procedurally-generated synthetic datasets (stellar survey, startup metrics, athletic combine) or import your own CSV, then drag-brush any cell to highlight matching points across every other cell simultaneously. Each cell's background tints by its Pearson correlation coefficient so patterns pop before you even look at the dots.
features: NxN brush-linked scatterplot matrix with per-cell Pearson r heat-tinting and histograms on the diagonal
3 procedurally-generated synthetic datasets with real latent-factor correlation structure, reshuffle with a new random seed
CSV import with automatic numeric-column + category detection, plus round-trip CSV export of the current selection or full dataset
PNG snapshot export, shareable URL-hash links (dataset + variables + seed), and full localStorage state persistence
tech: Seeded latent-factor synthetic data generation (mulberry32 + Box-Muller)
Custom CSV parser with numeric/category type inference

interaction.mouse: Hover a scatter cell for an axis tooltip; drag inside any off-diagonal cell to brush a rectangular selection
interaction.click: Click empty grid space to clear the current brush; toggle variable checkboxes to reshape the matrix
interaction.touch: Same brush-drag gesture via Pointer Events; hamburger button opens the side panel on narrow screens
interaction.keyboard: Escape clears the current brush selection
